items.name: mnemo
items.description: Long-term personal AI companion with persistent episodic + semantic memory, custom retrieval scoring, and personality.

items.name: LaminaAI
items.description: **LaminaAI** is a developer-friendly framework for building local, conversational AI assistants and companions with **long-term memory**, **context awareness**, and a **customizable personality**.

items.name: eros_ai
items.description: Eros AI is a deeply personal AI companion platform featuring a persistent memory, an evolving personality engine, and real-time emotional intelligence. Unlike generic chatbots, it maintains a long-term understanding by building a psychological profile through native voice and text chat interactions.

items.name: Companion
items.description: An open-source modular AI companion platform with long-term memory, personality, proactive interaction and hardware integration.

items.name: azzora-ai
items.description: Offline-first AI Companion Desktop powered by local LLMs with long-term memory, voice interaction, personality engine, and modular architecture.

items.name: AETHERAEON-AI-System
items.description: A next-generation AI framework that combines persistent memory, hybrid left/right-brain cognition, adaptive personality, contextual awareness, autonomous tool use, and long-term learning to create AI companions that grow alongside their owners.

items.name: mochi-llm-pet
items.description: Mochi is a transparent AI desktop companion powered by multimodal LLMs. It understands your screen, windows, active apps, and cursor, then reacts in character walking, watching, sleeping, sulking, and building long-term memories that shape its evolving personality.

items.name: companion-ai-assignment
items.description: Companion AI backend — long-term memory extraction and a personality engine, served over FastAPI REST endpoints

items.name: LingYa
items.description: A thoughtful AI companion with evolving personality, long-term memory, and situational awareness

items.name: sally
items.description: Advanced AI companion featuring multimodal conversations, long-term memory, vision capabilities, and an evolving emotional personality.
